description: Cayman Land Info is the portal of the Lands and Survey Department of the Cayman Islands, a British overseas territory, covering the land registry, cadastral survey, the national geographic information system (NGIS) and valuation. The site read on 2026-09-28 explains that the Land Register and Registry Map are public records defining parcels and ownership, lists services such as map requests, buffer maps, street addressing, an address locator and a residential property price index, and sells access to its map data in subscription packages: the Bronze package offers ownership data, address locations and the latest aerial imagery, and the Silver package adds elevation data, planning zones and historic overlays. Coverage is Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac and Little Cayman. Access is paid by subscription for the GIS data; the package terms were not read. Caveats: prices and data formats are not stated on the home page, and free open layers were not found. It supports hazard exposure analysis of buildings and parcels on low-lying islands, for example storm surge and sea level rise with the elevation data. No related Cayman GIS record is catalogued; the 2021 census housing tables complement it.
